entities.summary: Heinrich Friedrich Graf von Arnim-Heinrichsdorff-Werbelow was a Prussian statesman who played a crucial role in the unification of Germany during the Revolutions of 1848-1849. He was instrumental in the formation of the German National Assembly and served as its president. His leadership and diplomatic efforts helped to bring about a significant shift in the balance of power in Europe, paving the way for the eventual unification of Germany under Prussian leadership. The 1849 Frankfurt Parliament, which he participated in, was a pivotal moment in European history, as it marked the first time a unified German state had been represented at the European level. This moment laid the groundwork for the eventual formation of the German Empire under Otto von Bismarck, with Prussia at its helm. The impact of von Arnim-Heinrichsdorff-Werbelow's leadership can still be felt today, as Germany remains a dominant economic and political force in Europe.
